name: agent-orchestrator
description: Project planning, capability research and creation, optional retrieval and evidence-based delivery.

interface.longDescription: Plan project requirements, architecture and UI/UX, coordinate scoped implementation, maintain documentation, and cycle through independent review, security, QA and fixes. Reuse task-relevant agents, skills, plugins and connected MCP tools exposed by the host. Research open-source alternatives, create missing agents/skills/MCP integrations and adopt selected reviewed capabilities within authorized scope. Optional RAG planning keeps knowledge project-isolated; optional Jev/Laya-style decision routing proposes bounded choices with uncertainty escalation. These workflows supply no hosted MCP/A2A/model service, credentials or automatic installation permissions. Actual execution and independent agents depend on the host. Required local E2E and current hosted CI remain evidence gates; model scores cannot authorize actions or certify safety.
defaultPrompt: Plan my project: ask focused requirements questions, then design its architecture and user experience.
Coordinate this feature using the available tools and agents, inspect outputs, and complete review and QA.
Review release readiness: verify current-source E2E evidence, vulnerabilities, documentation and CI.
